messages:
Nadia: Found an old KMS grant that lets svc-build@redwood decrypt backups in gs://prod-archive. Not public yet.
sec-oncall: escalate to P1 containment: revoke grant, collect decrypt logs, rotate SA and Vault role.
Nadia: revoked binding: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/infra/locations/global/keyRING/key --member=serviceAccount:svc-build@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` and saved diff to /tmp/kms-diff.json
Omar: check if any helm charts or partner integrations reference svc-build. Ill grep infra repos.
Priya: Vault role `ci/agent` lists that key in allowed_kms_keys. We need to rebind role and issue short TTL wrapped keys.
rotor-bot: Reminder: runbook sec/rotate-ci-keys recommended. https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rotate-ci-keys
sec-oncall: create audit sink for Decrypt calls to sec-audit-bucket and scan gs://prod-archive for blobs with matching ciphertext headers.
Nadia: scan started (dry-run). If we find matches quarantine to gs://sec-quarantine and collect hashes.
Omar: found 1 helm release `legacy-ci` referencing svc-build in annotations; opening emergency PR to switch to Workload Identity.
Priya: after rotation, purge any secret caches (Optimize/agent cache) that might contain wrapped blobs.
sec-oncall: Document timeline and escalate to SecOps lead only if exfil confirmed. Keep updates in this thread.
Nadia: update: scan found one archived blob match. Quarantine copy started. Will attach checksums shortly.
